{
  "name": "statusline-hud",
  "displayName": "Statusline HUD",
  "version": "0.2.0",
  "description": "Live session HUD: context, rate-limit pace, per-request and per-turn cost, cache countdown and miss detection, compaction advisor, dashboard pane and a budget tool for the model; leaves out what Desktop already shows",
  "author": {
    "name": "Rui Quintino",
    "url": "https://github.com/rquintino"
  },
  "homepage": "https://github.com/rquintino/claude-code-xtras/tree/main/mods/statusline-hud",
  "repository": "https://github.com/rquintino/claude-code-xtras",
  "license": "MIT",
  "keywords": [
    "statusline",
    "hud",
    "cost",
    "context",
    "rate-limits",
    "prompt-cache",
    "mod"
  ],
  "types": "./types/index.d.ts",
  "userConfig": {
    "display": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Where to show the HUD",
      "description": "band: multi-row band above the prompt; status: one pinned line; both",
      "options": [
        "band",
        "status",
        "both"
      ],
      "default": "band"
    },
    "density": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Band density",
      "description": "full: six rows (tokens, last request, compaction advisor, env); compact: two rows",
      "options": [
        "full",
        "compact"
      ],
      "default": "full"
    },
    "cacheTtl": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Prompt cache TTL",
      "description": "auto follows Claude Code's rules (env vars, then 1h on a subscription within plan usage, else 5m); set it if you use the promptCacheTtl setting",
      "options": [
        "auto",
        "5m",
        "1h"
      ],
      "default": "auto"
    },
    "budgetUsd": {
      "type": "number",
      "title": "Session budget (USD)",
      "description": "Toast once and turn the cost red when the session passes it; 0 turns it off",
      "default": 0,
      "min": 0
    },
    "alerts": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "title": "Toast alerts",
      "description": "Context 80/90%, rate-limit pace, cache about to go cold, budget",
      "default": true
    },
    "turnCost": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "title": "Turn cost",
      "description": "Show what the running turn has cost beside the spinner, and each finished turn's cost on its closing line",
      "default": true
    }
  }
}
